This is a documentation-quality issue, not evidence of hidden behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Local storage of email addresses, order IDs, and status history is expected for this tracker and is disclosed, though README privacy guidance could be stronger about file permissions, retention, backups, and avoiding commits.
[SQP-2] expected: Submitting email/order IDs to track.evenrealities.com is intrinsic to checking order status and is described in the workflow; the disclosure could be more prominent, especially for scheduled repeated checks.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable storing email/order IDs and status history in local plaintext files, submitting that information to Evenrealities on each check, installing Playwright browser components, and optionally running a daily cron job. Keep the memory files out of version control and shared folders, and remove the cron job when you no longer want automated checks.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: evenrealities-tracker
Version: 1.2.0

The skill is designed for order tracking using Playwright browser automation, targeting a single, public website (track.evenrealities.com). The `scripts/tracker.py` includes robust input validation for email and order IDs, preventing injection into the browser context. All configuration and history files are stored securely within the designated `memory/` directory. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts against the AI agent in the documentation. The use of Playwright is constrained and appears to be for its intended purpose without introducing significant vulnerabilities or malicious intent.
